fields.label: Precise theorem
fields.text: Definition 9 (tokens with classical verification, parameters n,m,N_Mint,N_Verify,t,eps_loss,eps_fraud); Construction 10 meets Def.9 with n=k, m=k 2^{k/4}, N_Mint=2^{k/4}, N_Verify=2^{k/2}, t=k, eps_loss=2^{-k/2}, eps_fraud=2^{-k/4} (4|k); Definition 11 repetitive tokens; Claim 12 (repetitive scheme -> Def.9 scheme); Claim 13 anonymity/audit via swap test; Construction 15 main scheme.

fields.label: Input model
fields.text: Bank mints identical (repetitive) single-use quantum tokens; users hold quantum tokens.

fields.label: Verifier model
fields.text: Classical bill validation (no long-term quantum memory / quantum communication for verification); users audit bank via swap test between tokens.

fields.label: Adversary capabilities
fields.text: Unforgeability: unconditional (query-bound argument, Lemma 8 generalising [FGGS99,Vel13]). Anonymity: detects bank tracking attempts with probability bounded in Claim 13.

fields.label: Proof dependencies
fields.text: Swap test chain inequality (Claims 5-6); quantum query lower bound Lemma 8.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.text: Single-use tokens; anonymity requires users to exchange pattern tokens; not composable with S-money or Wiesner proofs.

fields.label: What QMint adds
fields.text: Nothing; frontier lane O1 reading only. Not to be merged with S1/S2/D1 theorems.
